identity.title: Submillimeter-HCN Diagram for Energy Diagnostics in the Centers of Galaxies

paper_type_evidence.quote: Compiling data from literature and the ALMA archive, we show enhanced HCN(4-3)/HCO$^+$(4-3) and/or HCN(4-3)/CS(7-6) integrated intensity ratios in circumnuclear molecular gas around active galactic nuclei (AGNs)

evidence.quote: 35 pc $\times$ 28 pc at the assumed distance of NGC 1068 = 14.4 Mpc

question.value: Do AGNs show enhanced HCN(4-3)/HCO+(4-3) and HCN(4-3)/CS(7-6) ratios compared with starbursts, and is the cause abundance or excitation (non-LTE RADEX modeling)?

evidence.quote: In this paper, we compile literature and archival data of HCN(4-3), HCO$^+$(4-3), and CS(7-6) emission lines of various AGNs and SB galaxies to improve the statistics of the submm-HCN diagram, and to explore the cause of the HCN-enhancement.
we used ALMA band 7 data retrieved from the ALMA Science Archive[^2] (ID = 2011.0.00083.S)
we used ALMA band 7 data retrieved from the ALMA Science Archive
The synthesized beams and the rms noises in channel maps of the target emission lines were typically 0$''$.5 $\times$ 0$''$.4
and 2.5 mJy beam$^{-1}$, respectively

pi_or_archival_as_stated.value: Archival, previously presented by Garcia-Burillo et al. 2014 and Viti et al. 2014

evidence.quote: Although this data was already presented extensively in (cite: 2014A&A...567A.125G) and (cite: 2014A&A...570A..28V), we re-analyzed the data

other_facilities.name: APEX, JCMT, SMA, ASTE, other ALMA projects

provided.value: Literature line ratios for other galaxies

evidence.quote: we first compiled interferometric data of the target emission lines of extragalactic objects from literatures.

what.value: Line ratios for NGC 1097, NGC 7469, M82, NGC 253, NGC 1614, LMC, APEX sample, etc. (Table 1)

evidence.quote: The resultant HCN(4-3)/HCO$^+$(4-3) and HCN(4-3)/CS(7-6) line ratios of each data point
We assume the absolute flux uncertainty to be 15%.

unstated_but_needed: MIRIAD reduction steps and calibration details for 2011.0.00083.S
Line-integration velocity ranges and aperture/regions for AGN, E-knot, W-knot, CND-N, CND-S
RADEX collision-rate files and linewidth assumed

analysis_steps.goal: Measure line ratios in NGC 1068 from ALMA data

method.value: Re-analysis of archival Band 7 data to get integrated-intensity ratios at several positions

evidence.quote: we re-analyzed the data to obtain high resolution values of the $R_{\rm HCN/HCO^+}$ and $R_{\rm HCN/CS}$

validation.value: Rms and fluxes agree with published data

evidence.quote: The rms noises and measured fluxes of these lines are in good agreement with the published data.

method.value: RADEX grid over Tkin (50,100,200 K), nH2 (1e5, 5e6), abundance ratio (1,10), Tbg (2.73-60 K), N/dV; spherical escape probability

evidence.quote: The cases of 50, 100, and 200 K are investigated.

assumptions.value: Homogeneous single-phase spherical cloud; blackbody background

evidence.quote: As for the cloud geometry, we assumed a spherical one.

fitting.value: No fitting; grid comparison with observed ratios

evidence.quote: Note that we do not intend to mimic an environment of a specific galaxy here. Moreover, one line ratio can be reproduced by various combinations of parameters.

validation.value: Compared with NGC 1097, NGC 1068, NGC 4418 and with LTE results in the literature

evidence.loc: 4.5 Comparison with real galaxies: Case study of NGC 1097, NGC 1068, and NGC 4418
evidence.quote: we briefly compare our model calculations with the observed $R_{\rm HCN/HCO^+}$ and/or $R_{\rm HCN/CS}$ of two instructive AGNs and one buried-AGN, namely NGC 1097, NGC 1068, and NGC 4418.
We used MIRIAD ((cite: 1995ASPC...77..433S)) for this analysis.
we ran non-LTE radiative transfer models with the RADEX code

findings_qualitative.value: AGNs show higher HCN/HCO+ and/or HCN/CS (4-3) ratios than SBs at high resolution; model needs HCN abundance boosted by a few to >=10 in AGNs, though higher density is not excluded

evidence.quote: one can find a clear trend that AGNs exhibit higher $R_{\rm HCN/HCO^+}$ and/or $R_{\rm HCN/CS}$ than SB galaxies

claims.hypothesis: AGNs have enhanced submm HCN ratios vs SB
claims.result: AGNs higher in high-res sample; low-res AGNs (NGC 1365, 4945) look like SB
claims.finding: Diagram is a potential diagnostic needing high resolution

evidence.quote: We expect this feature could potentially be an extinction-free energy diagnostic tool of nuclear regions of galaxies.

claims.result: X_HCN/X_HCO+ >~10 needed in AGNs vs ~3 in SB at n=1e5
claims.finding: Abundance enhancement preferred but higher AGN density cannot be excluded

evidence.loc: 4.4 Dependence of the line ratios on gas density
evidence.quote: we hereafter prefer the scenario that the variation of underlying molecular abundances between AGNs and SB galaxies as the prime cause of the HCN-enhancement.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Systematically higher gas density in AGNs not discarded

evidence.quote: we could not fully discard the possibility that the systematically higher gas density in AGNs than in SB galaxies is a cause of the HCN-enhancement

limitations_admitted.value: Simple single-zone models; buried AGNs may be affected by absorption/IR pumping

evidence.quote: the latter scenario was not fully discarded because of the simplified modelings in this work

referee_caveats_inferred: Small sample; heterogeneous telescopes and apertures
Model grid is not fit to data

evidence.quote: we used ALMA band 7 data retrieved from the ALMA Science Archive

reproducibility.score_reason: ALMA part is small and sparsely described; the RADEX grid is well specified.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The ALMA reduction recipe is incomplete and most data come from the literature.
